evidence: Touches fuzz harnesses across 3 files to fix state pollution across fuzz iterations, carrying the Fuzzing label.
rationale: Fixes non-deterministic coverage tracking and failure to reproduce crash inputs in isolation across five mempool fuzz targets. By calling DisableNextWrite() per iteration, it removes inter-iteration state leakage from FlushStateToDisk(PERIODIC), mirroring the solution from PR #32822.
